kebab_example: aliyun sls delete-context-model-element --name orders --domain sls --kind log_set --element-name orders_log --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteContextModelElement

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the context model to which the element belongs. It is obtained from the first segment of the request path /context-models/{name}/elements/{domain}/{kind}/{elementName}. If the model does not exist, a 404 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 元素所属的上下文模型标识，取自请求路径 /context-models/{name}/elements/{domain}/{kind}/{elementName} 的第一段；模型不存在时返回 404
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The domain of the element. This parameter, together with kind and elementName, uniquely identifies the element to be deleted. For elements automatically generated by Simple Log Service, the domain is usually sls
parameters.help_zh: 元素的所属域，与 kind、elementName 一起唯一确定一个待删除的元素。由日志服务自动生成的元素，其所属域通常为 sls
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The type of the element. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores are supported. Hyphens are not supported. Examples include log_set, metric_set, runbook_set, event_set, sls_logstore, and storage_link
parameters.help_zh: 元素类型，仅支持大小写字母、数字与下划线（不含短横线），例如 log_set、metric_set、runbook_set、event_set、sls_logstore、storage_link
parameters.name: kind

parameters.help_en: The name of the element itself, which corresponds to the metadata.name of the element and is distinct from the model name. Uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and the . _ - : @ characters are supported. Examples include orders_log and st.myproj.orders-ls
parameters.help_zh: 元素自身的名称，即元素 metadata.name，区别于所属模型名；支持大小写字母、数字与 . _ - : @，例如 orders_log、st.myproj.orders-ls
parameters.name: element_name

status.description_en: The status of the operation. The value success is returned when the deletion is successful. Deleting a non-existent element also returns success
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。删除成功时固定返回 success；删除一个并不存在的元素同样返回 success
